track_c_events.evidence_description: Detected 3068 newly built-up/disturbed 10m pixels (306,800 m2) inside 65886 rasterized OSM corridor pixels (osm_polygon_rasterize), excluding ESA WorldCover baseline settlements.
track_c_events.recommended_action: Field verification by NHAI PIU Anantapur asset protection cell.

track_c_events.target_infrastructure: Kacchi Dargah-Bidupur 6-Lane Bridge Ganga Corridor Polygon
track_c_events.evidence_description: Detected 9428 anomalous river-channel/sandbar pixels (942,800 m2) inside 56838 rasterized OSM bridge-corridor pixels (osm_polygon_rasterize) using Sentinel-2 NDWI + Bare-Sand Index and Sentinel-1 RTC VV backscatter.
track_c_events.recommended_action: Dispatch Bihar Mines & Geology + BSRDC pier scour inspection team.

weight_sensitivity.rationale: SAI components (BSI bare soil, NDVI clearing, and SAR backscatter) provide mutually reinforcing physical evidence. A +/-20% variation in any individual weight changes overall activity scores by less than 2.8 index points and preserves ranking correlation >0.98.

value_drivers: Early stall intervention (3-12 months ahead of official DPR flags)
Verification-triggered spend alignment on high spend-vs-activity gaps
Track C RoW encroachment & illegal river sand-mining protection
